candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Preview Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the companion picking screen into a full stage layout featuring live desktop preview animations before confirming adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (60.9% conversion) and long median completion time (89s), showing users need a clearer preview of how pets look on screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pet Control & Desktop Interaction Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right after home intro showing step-by-step instructions on how to summon, hide, and talk to the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails after onboarding from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.

new_controls_guide.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_guide.body: Use quick shortcuts to interact, bring your pet to the front, or hide it when working.

components.text: Press Alt+P to summon or hide pet

guard.reason: Adds a controls guide screen after home_intro as allowed by Rule 4 without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 35.2% finish dropoff supported by user emails, but requires a brand new screen.

candidates.title: Split Screen Path Chooser
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a side-by-side split layout explicitly contrasting fast adoption vs photo custom creation.
candidates.why: The choose_path step sees a high mean duration of 514s, indicating path confusion and choice paralysis early in the flow.

path_options.text: Instant Companion vs Custom Photo Pet

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Before Final Home Intro
candidates.change: Reorder sign-in to appear after generation finishes and right before home intro so users experience pet creation before account setup.
candidates.why: Sign-in dropoff is 24.6% and 8 users reported missing pets after signing in with wrong accounts; placing sign-in after pet creation ties account creation directly to saving the custom pet.

guard.reason: Reorders sign_in within onboarding, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in directly targets 24.6% dropoff and reported missing pet account issues.

candidates.title: Pet Photo Verification Flow
candidates.change: Add an image pre-check step inside photo upload to validate clarity and format before pet generation.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets where custom pet generation failed or produced corrupted visual assets.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Warning
candidates.change: Display an account pet sync notice on the sign-in screen informing returning users that logging into an existing account restores saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were logged regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with different login methods.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account will restore all your previously saved pets.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Spotlight Desktop Rendering Status Screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with a spotlight layout that shows active desktop rendering health status and fallback setup help.
candidates.why: High mean waiting time (2336s) and 3 support emails reported the pet failing to show up on the desktop after generation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Welcome Starter Treat Pack Incentive
candidates.change: Add a free starter pet toy & treat pack reward banner on the home intro screen upon completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long completion time (mean 5815s), needing an immediate incentive to complete setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready + Free Starter Toy Pack Unlocked!

guard.reason: Mentions free extras and bonus items in onboarding copy, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Health Diagnostic Indicator
candidates.change: Show a real-time desktop window system check progress bar on the waiting screen to verify screen permissions.
candidates.why: Support received tickets about pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch post-generation.

components.text: Verifying desktop screen permissions & graphics acceleration...

guard.reason: Adds a diagnostic progress indicator to the waiting screen without losing core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adds diagnostic info for home step issues backed by support tickets; moderate effort.

candidates.title: Quick Story Setup Expectation Banner
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and body copy to set clear expectations that setup takes under 60 seconds.
candidates.why: Initial story/choose_path phase exhibits extreme mean duration (514s), suggesting users delay starting.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion in Under 60 Seconds
story.body: Pick a companion, give it a name, and watch it live on your desktop instantly.

guard.reason: Updates story copy to set setup expectations while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting extreme delay (514s mean duration) in initial step.

picked: Move Sign-In Before Final Home Intro

decisions.title: Move Sign-In Before Final Home Intro
